product: JAR tasks on serverless compute are now generally available
tagline: Package Scala or Java code as a JAR and run it as a task in a Lakeflow Job on serverless compute.
what_it_does: Package Scala or Java code as a JAR and run it as a task in a Lakeflow Job on serverless compute. Your JAR must match the Scala, Java Development Kit (JDK), and Databricks Connect versions of your serverless environment version. important Databricks strongly recommends Declarative Automation Bundles instead of building and deploying JARs manually as described on this page.
why_it_matters: Credentials, lineage, and governance are handled for you.
plain_summary: Package Scala or Java code as a JAR and run it as a task in a Lakeflow Job on serverless compute. Your JAR must match the Scala, Java Development Kit (JDK), and Databricks Connect versions of your serverless environment version.
key_takeaway: Package Scala or Java code as a JAR and run it as a task in a Lakeflow Job on serverless compute.
